name: FWD Easy 360 Product Viewer
author: FWD

sections.description:
FWD Easy 360 Product Viewer is a rich-feature image rotator that lets you display products from multiple angles using one or two axes (horizontal and vertical).

It supports 2D, 3D, and linear image sequences, deep zoom, markers/hotspots, optional controls, touch gestures, and WooCommerce integration.

The plugin includes admin managers for presets, products, sets, images, and markers, plus a shortcode generator for fast integration in posts, pages, custom post types, and product descriptions.

  • Product page
  • Demos
  • Video tutorial
  • Contact/support
  • Buy WordPress plugin
  • Buy JavaScript version

Pro Version

Markers/hotspots settings are available in the separate
Pro version/plugin.

The free plugin remains fully functional for all features included in this package.

Main Features

  • Fully responsive and mobile optimized.
  • Display 2D, 3D, and linear products.
  • Horizontal rotation, vertical rotation, or both axes.
  • Unlimited images and unlimited image sets.
  • Start at a specific set and/or image.
  • Deep zoom with high image quality workflows.
  • Drag and spin with adjustable sensitivity.
  • Customizable rotation speed and slideshow speed.
  • Optional lazy loading / lazy scrolling initialization.
  • Markers/hotspots: link, small info window, and detailed info window, (Pro version).
  • Built-in marker position helper, (Pro version).
  • Navigator window for panning while zoomed.
  • Optional controls: rotate/pan, left/right, zoom in/out, play, info, link, fullscreen.
  • Zoom scrollbar and customizable zoom factor.
  • Keyboard, mouse wheel, and pinch-zoom gesture support.
  • Custom right-click context menu.
  • Vector and PNG skin workflows.
  • Powerful API and events.
  • WooCommerce support.
  • Documentation and video tutorials.

Shortcode

Basic example:

[fwd360pv preset_id=”preset_name” product_id=”product_name”]

Attributes:

  • preset_id: Preset name/id created in General Settings.
  • product_id: Product name/id created in Products Manager.

Development

This plugin’s full source code is publicly available for transparency and verification.
Developed and maintained by FutureWebDesign.

  • Source code & build tools — includes original uncompiled files and Vite build configuration.
  • Distributed plugin uses a compiled build generated by Vite for optimal performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins in WordPress admin.
  3. Open FWD Easy 360 Product Viewer admin and create at least one preset and one product.
  4. Add at least one set and one image to the product.
  5. Insert the shortcode into a page, post, custom post type, or WooCommerce product description.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Gutenberg?

Yes. Use the shortcode in any block that supports shortcodes.

Can I use it in WooCommerce product pages?

Yes. Add the shortcode in the WooCommerce product description.

Can I create both horizontal and vertical rotation?

Yes. The viewer supports multiple image sets for one or two axis rotation.

Does it support hotspots/markers?

Yes. You can add link markers, small info markers, and detailed info markers, (Pro version).

Is deep zoom supported?

Yes. Deep zoom and pan features are included.

Can I customize controls and skin?

Yes. Controls are optional and highly configurable, with vector and PNG skin workflows.
